<!--
Thanks for the suggestion! Before filling this out, please consider:

1. Could this be a plugin instead? CodeSynapt has an extensible
   plugin API for themes, exporters, parsers, layouts, panels, and
   actions. See plugin-api/README.md.

2. Is this a duplicate? Search existing issues + discussions first.

3. Is this a question, not a feature request? Try Discussions instead.
-->

## What problem are you trying to solve?

<!--
Describe the underlying problem, not the proposed solution.
Example: "When my project has 5,000+ files, finding a specific one
is hard because the file tree is so long" — not "add a search box
to the file tree."

The problem-first framing helps us design the right solution.
-->

## How are you working around it today?

<!--
What do you currently do to deal with this? Other tools, workflows,
manual steps? This helps us understand the severity.
-->

## What would you like to see?

<!--
Your proposed solution. Be as concrete as possible — UI mockups,
example commands, sample API, etc. It's fine to have multiple
proposals.
-->

## Could this be a plugin?

<!--
Check whichever applies:
- [ ] Yes — but I'd like guidance on which plugin type fits
- [ ] No, because: <explain>
- [ ] I don't know
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Other approaches you've thought about, even if you rejected them. -->

## Who would this help?

<!--
- Just you? That's fine — many features start with one user.
- A specific group (e.g. "people working on monorepos with 100k+ files")?
- Everyone?

This helps us understand the impact.
-->

## Additional context

<!--
Screenshots, references to similar features in other tools, links to
discussions, anything else.
-->

Before submitting:

-->
